for_sale_item.tooltip: On the mainland shelf. Buy it with coins and it goes to the bottom of your deck.

for_sale_art.tooltip: Found on the island. Buy it with compasses and it goes to the bottom of your deck.

zones.label: Research
zones.tooltip: Two tokens climb this track. The notebook may never sit above the magnifying glass, and only the glass may reach the Lost Temple.

zones.label: Artifacts
zones.tooltip: The artifact half of the card row. It grows by one slot every round as the moon staff moves.

zones.label: Items
zones.tooltip: The item half of the card row. It loses one slot every round as the moon staff moves.

zones.label: The island
zones.tooltip: Five known sites along the bottom, unexplored Level I positions above them, Level II above those.

zones.label: Deck
zones.tooltip: Your expedition deck. It is never reshuffled during a round — only at the round's end.

zones.label: Played
zones.tooltip: Everything you played this round. At the round's end it is shuffled and put under your deck.

zones.label: Idols
zones.tooltip: Three points each, whether you ever use them or not.

zones.label: Assistants
zones.tooltip: Recruited from the research track. Each works once a round.

phases.label: One main action, and as many free ones as you like

cards.story: Five rounds, and the island keeps the rest of its secrets. Count the idols, the guardians you faced down, what the notebooks are worth and what the fear cost you.
